$comment: SEED registry of Claude Design project ids. This file is a CACHE OF CANDIDATES, not a source of truth.
Every entry must be re-confirmed at runtime with `DesignSync method:get_project projectId:<id>` before it is
offered to the user — ids are per-environment and per-login, and an id that resolves for one teammate can
404 for another. `access` and `tokenFile` are hints that save a round-trip; the live get_project/list_files
This shipped copy is overwritten whenever the plugin updates. The live registry lives at
~/.claude/avista-claude-design/design-systems.json and takes precedence — newly discovered systems are
appended there so they survive `/plugin update`.

systems.name: Avista Design System
systems.note: The reason this plugin exists: absent from list_projects entirely, but get_project/list_files/get_file all work by id. get_project returns no canEdit field, which is how read-only presents.

systems.name: RMK Design System
systems.note: get_project returns canEdit:true on jontryggvi@avista.is, and it is the only project list_projects returns for that login. Access differs per teammate — always re-read canEdit rather than trusting this field.
